name: Lyndhurst Summer Day Camp
operator_name: Township of Lyndhurst, Lyndhurst Board of Education and AlphaBEST
description_short: Six week day camp at Roosevelt School in Lyndhurst for children entering kindergarten through grade 5, run by the township and Board of Education with AlphaBEST: sports, crafts, STEM projects, weekly themes and field trips at no extra cost.
notes: 8 am to 3 pm, extended care to 6 pm. Full six weeks or single weeks at $205 per week; discounts for siblings, active duty military families and families who qualify for free or reduced lunch or other subsidies. The letter gives no 2026 dates for this camp; the township's summer programs ran June 22 to August 21, 2026. The same page lists separate sports, theater and arts programs run by outside providers, not included here.

for_andrew: No dates for this camp: the letter says six weeks but not which. List it without sessions?

The Lyndhurst page also lists about a dozen short programs run by outside providers (baseball, soccer, basketball, cheer, volleyball, theater, Wonder Girls, USA Sports). Each has its own dates, ages and site, but the only source is the township's summary PDF, not each provider's own page, so I did not draft them. Want them researched from the providers' sites?
